_source: Extracted from the fan card-list HTML (project cards #213-#261 and corporations #CORP13-#CORP17).

_conventions.tags: Same spelling as cards_material.csv: power tag is 'Energy', events carry 'Event'
_conventions.requirement: null, or {type: venus, min|max: %} | {type: tags, tags: {Tag: count}} | {type: floaters, min} | {type: tr, min}
_conventions.vp: number, or {amount, per, resource} meaning 'amount' VP per 'per' resources on this card
_conventions.holds: Resource type kept on the card, if any

projectCards.name: Aerial Mappers
projectCards.action: Add 1 floater to ANY card, or spend 1 floater here to draw 1 card.

projectCards.name: Aerosport Tournament
projectCards.text: Requires that you have 5 floaters. Gain 1 M€ for each city tile in play.

projectCards.name: Air-Scrapping Expedition
projectCards.text: Raise Venus 1 step. Add 3 floaters to ANY Venus card.

projectCards.name: Atalanta Planitia Lab
projectCards.text: Requires 3 science tags. Draw 2 cards.

projectCards.name: Atmoscoop
projectCards.text: Requires 3 science tags. Either raise the temperature 2 steps, or raise Venus 2 steps. Add 2 floaters to ANY card.

projectCards.name: Comet for Venus
projectCards.text: Raise Venus 1 step. Remove up to 4 M€ from any player WITH A VENUS TAG IN PLAY.

projectCards.name: Corroder Suits
projectCards.text: Increase your M€ production 2 steps. Add 1 resource to ANY Venus card.

projectCards.name: Dawn City
projectCards.text: Requires 4 science tags. Decrease your energy production 1 step. Increase your titanium production 1 step. Place a city tile on the RESERVED AREA.

projectCards.name: Deuterium Export
projectCards.action: Add 1 floater to this card, OR spend 1 floater here to increase your energy production 1 step.

projectCards.name: Dirigibles
projectCards.effect: When playing a Venus tag, floaters here may be used as payment, and are worth 3 M€ each.

projectCards.name: Extractor Balloons
projectCards.text: Add 3 floaters to this card.
projectCards.action: Add 1 floater to this card, or remove 2 floaters here to raise Venus 1 step.

projectCards.name: Extremophiles
projectCards.text: Requires 2 science tags.

projectCards.name: Floating Habs
projectCards.text: Requires 2 science tags.
projectCards.action: Spend 2 M€ to add 1 floater to ANY card.

projectCards.name: Forced Precipitation
projectCards.action: Spend 2 M€ to add 1 floater to this card, OR spend 2 floaters here to increase Venus 1 step.

projectCards.name: Freyja Biodomes
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 10%. Add 2 microbes or 2 animals to ANOTHER Venus card. Decrease your energy production 1 step and increase your M€ production 2 steps.

projectCards.name: GHG Import From Venus
projectCards.text: Raise Venus 1 step. Increase your heat production 3 steps.

projectCards.name: Giant Solar Shade
projectCards.text: Raise Venus 3 steps.

projectCards.name: Gyropolis
projectCards.text: Decrease your energy production 2 steps. Increase your M€ production 1 step for each Venus and Earth tag you have. Place a city tile.

projectCards.name: Hydrogen to Venus
projectCards.text: Raise Venus 1 step. Add 1 floater to A Venus card for each Jovian tag you have.

projectCards.name: Io Sulphur Research
projectCards.text: Draw 1 card, or draw 3 if you have at least 3 Venus tags.

projectCards.name: Ishtar Mining
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 8%. Increase your titanium production 1 step.

projectCards.name: Jet Stream Microscrappers
projectCards.action: Spend 1 titanium to add 2 floaters here, OR spend 2 floaters here to raise Venus 1 step.

projectCards.name: Local Shading
projectCards.action: Add 1 floater to this card, or spend 1 floater here to raise your M€ production 1 step.

projectCards.name: Luna Metropolis
projectCards.text: Increase your M€ production 1 step for each Earth tag you have, including this. Place a city tile on the RESERVED AREA.

projectCards.name: Luxury Foods
projectCards.text: Requires that you have a Venus tag, an Earth tag and a Jovian tag.

projectCards.name: Maxwell Base
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 12%. Decrease your energy production 1 step. Place a city tile ON THE RESERVED AREA.
projectCards.action: Add 1 resource to ANOTHER Venus card.

projectCards.name: Mining Quota
projectCards.text: Requires Venus, Earth and Jovian tags. Increase your steel production 2 steps.

projectCards.name: Neutralizer Factory
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 10%. Increase the Venus track 1 step.

projectCards.name: Omnicourt
projectCards.text: Requires Venus, Earth and Jovian tags. Increase your TR 2 steps.

projectCards.name: Orbital Reflectors
projectCards.text: Raise Venus 2 steps. Increase your heat production 2 steps.

projectCards.name: Rotator Impacts
projectCards.text: Venus must be 14% or lower.
projectCards.action: Spend 6 M€ to add an asteroid resource to this card (TITANIUM MAY BE USED), or spend 1 resource from this card to increase Venus 1 step.

projectCards.name: Sister Planet Support
projectCards.text: Requires Venus and Earth tags. Increase your M€ production 3 steps.

projectCards.name: Solarnet
projectCards.text: Requires Venus, Earth and Jovian tags. Draw 2 cards.

projectCards.name: Spin-Inducing Asteroid
projectCards.text: Venus must be 10% or lower. Raise Venus 2 steps.

projectCards.name: Sponsored Academies
projectCards.text: Discard 1 card from your hand and THEN draw 3 cards. All OPPONENTS draw 1 card.

projectCards.name: Stratopolis
projectCards.text: Requires 2 science tags. Increase your M€ production 2 steps. Place a city tile ON THE RESERVED AREA.
projectCards.action: Add 2 floaters to ANY Venus card.

projectCards.name: Stratospheric Birds
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 12% and that you spend 1 floater from any card.

projectCards.name: Sulphur Exports
projectCards.text: Increase Venus 1 step. Increase your M€ production 1 step for each Venus tag you have, including this.

projectCards.name: Sulphur-Eating Bacteria
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 6%.
projectCards.action: Add 1 microbe to this card, or spend any number of microbes here to gain triple amount of M€.

projectCards.name: Terraforming Contract
projectCards.text: Requires that you have at least 25 TR. Increase your M€ production 4 steps.

projectCards.name: Thermophiles
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 6%.
projectCards.action: Add 1 microbe to ANY Venus card, or spend 2 microbes here to raise Venus 1 step.

projectCards.name: Water to Venus
projectCards.text: Raise Venus 1 step.

projectCards.name: Venus Governor
projectCards.text: Requires 2 Venus tags. Increase your M€ production 2 steps.

projectCards.name: Venus Magnetizer
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 10%.
projectCards.action: Decrease your energy production 1 step to raise Venus 1 step.

projectCards.name: Venus Soils
projectCards.text: Raise Venus 1 step. Increase your plant production 1 step. Add 2 microbes to ANOTHER card.

projectCards.name: Venus Waystation
projectCards.effect: When you play a Venus tag, you pay 2 M€ less for it.

projectCards.name: Venusian Animals
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 18%.
projectCards.effect: When you play a Science tag, including this, add 1 animal to this card.

projectCards.name: Venusian Insects
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 12%.

projectCards.name: Venusian Plants
projectCards.text: Requires Venus 16%. Raise Venus 1 step. Add 1 microbe or 1 animal to ANOTHER Venus card.

corporations.name: Aphrodite
corporations.text: You start with 1 plant production and 47 M€.
corporations.effect: Whenever Venus is terraformed 1 step, you gain 2 M€.

corporations.name: Celestic
corporations.firstAction: Reveal cards from the deck until you have revealed 2 cards with a floater icon on it. Take those 2 cards into hand and discard the rest.
corporations.action: Add a floater to ANY card.

corporations.name: Manutech
corporations.text: You start with 1 steel production and 35 M€.
corporations.effect: For each step you increase the production of a resource, including this, you also gain that resource.

corporations.name: Morning Star Inc.
corporations.firstAction: Reveal cards from the deck until you have revealed 3 Venus-tag cards. Take those into hand and discard the rest.
corporations.effect: Your Venus requirements are +/- 2 steps, your choice in each case.

corporations.name: Viron
corporations.action: Use a blue card action that has already been used this generation.
